A '''florist''' was an individual who sold [[Plant/Legends|flowers]] for a living. [[ConJob]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], ran a [[ConJob's Trifles|flower stall]] on the [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].
